query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'A blocked catch basin looks like a minor problem until your parking lot is underwater. Discount Drain cleans and restores catch basins for residential properties, commercial lots, and municipal road systems across London and Southwestern Ontario.',
  longDesc = 'Catch basins collect runoff from driveways, parking lots, and roadways and channel it into the storm sewer system before it pools on the surface or works its way into buildings. When they fill with sediment, leaves, gravel, and debris, they stop doing that job. The water backs up, and the flooding starts. It is a simple problem with a straightforward fix, but it causes a lot of damage when it gets ignored.\n\nMost property owners do not think about their catch basins until there is standing water in the parking lot after a rainstorm, or until a municipal inspector flags the basin as non-compliant. By that point, the basin has often been neglected for years. Sediment has compacted at the bottom, the grate is partially blocked, and the outlet pipe has become restricted. Cleaning it out at that stage takes more time and equipment than regular maintenance would have required.\n\nDiscount Drain uses a combination vac and power flushing truck to clean catch basins. The vac truck removes accumulated sediment, debris, and standing water from the basin sump. Where the outlet pipe has become restricted, we flush it with high-pressure water to restore full flow. For basins with structural damage, cracked walls, or deteriorated frames and grates, we carry out repairs on the same visit where possible, so you are not scheduling two separate service calls for what should be one job.\n\nCommercial properties with large parking lots or loading areas typically have multiple catch basins that all need attention at the same time. We schedule commercial cleaning programs that cover all basins on the property in a single mobilization, which is more efficient than individual service calls and ensures that every basin is working before the spring thaw or the fall leaf season. Many property managers set up annual cleaning contracts with us so the work gets done on a set schedule without having to remember to call.\n\nFor municipalities and road authorities, catch basin maintenance is a regulatory obligation as well as a practical one. Blocked basins on municipal roads contribute to road flooding, ice formation in winter, and accelerated pavement deterioration. We work with municipalities across Southwestern Ontario to clean and inspect catch basins as part of their annual infrastructure maintenance programs, providing written condition reports for each basin before and after service.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"Vac Truck Cleaning","description":"We use a combination vac and power flushing truck to remove compacted sediment, debris, and standing water from the basin sump in a single visit."},{"title":"Outlet Pipe Flushing","description":"When the outlet pipe is restricted, we flush it with high-pressure water on the same visit to restore full drainage capacity to the storm sewer system."},{"title":"Same-Visit Repairs","description":"Cracked walls, deteriorated frames, and damaged grates are repaired during the cleaning visit where possible, avoiding the cost and delay of a second service call."},{"title":"Commercial Maintenance Programs","description":"We clean all catch basins on commercial properties in a single mobilization and offer annual contracts so maintenance happens on a predictable schedule."},{"title":"Municipal Compliance Documentation","description":"Every catch basin we service receives a written condition report, which municipalities and property managers can use for regulatory compliance and maintenance records."},{"title":"Year-Round Availability","description":"We schedule catch basin cleaning before spring thaw, after fall leaf season, and on an emergency basis when flooding is already occurring. We are available 24 hours a day for urgent situations."}]',
  faqs = '[{"question":"How often should catch basins be cleaned?","answer":"For most residential properties, once a year is sufficient. Commercial properties with high traffic or large impervious surfaces may need cleaning twice a year. Municipal catch basins on heavily used roads are typically cleaned annually as part of a scheduled maintenance program. If you are seeing slow drainage or standing water after rain, the basin likely needs attention sooner."},{"question":"What happens if a catch basin is not cleaned regularly?","answer":"Sediment and debris accumulate in the basin sump over time. Once the sump fills, debris starts to block the outlet pipe and the grate opening. The result is surface flooding during rain events, which can damage pavement, erode landscaping, and allow water to enter buildings. In winter, blocked basins contribute to ice formation on driveways and parking lots."},{"question":"Can you clean a catch basin that has been neglected for years?","answer":"Yes. Heavily silted basins take longer to clean and may require multiple passes with the vac truck, but we handle them regularly. In some cases where sediment has hardened, we use high-pressure flushing to break it up before vacuuming. We will assess the condition on arrival and give you an honest estimate of the work required."},{"question":"Do you repair catch basins as well as clean them?","answer":"Yes. We repair cracked basin walls, replace deteriorated frames and grates, and reline basins that have structural damage. Where repairs are straightforward, we carry them out on the same visit as the cleaning. For more extensive reconstruction, we schedule a follow-up appointment."},{"question":"What is the difference between a catch basin and a storm sewer?","answer":"A catch basin is the surface collection point, typically the grated inlet you see in a parking lot or at the curb. The storm sewer is the underground pipe network that the catch basin drains into. Catch basin cleaning addresses the collection point and the short outlet pipe. Storm sewer cleaning and inspection is a separate service that we also provide."},{"question":"How long does catch basin cleaning take?","answer":"A single residential catch basin typically takes 30 to 60 minutes to clean. Commercial properties with multiple basins take longer depending on the number of basins and their condition. We give you a time estimate when we schedule the job."},{"question":"Is catch basin cleaning covered by insurance or required by the municipality?","answer":"In most cases, catch basin maintenance on private property is the responsibility of the property owner and is not covered by standard property insurance. Some municipalities require property owners to maintain catch basins on their property in working order and may issue notices of violation if a basin is blocked and causing drainage problems onto public property."},{"question":"Do you provide catch basin cleaning for condominium corporations and property management companies?","answer":"Yes. We work with property management companies, condominium corporations, and commercial landlords across Southwestern Ontario. We can set up annual service agreements that cover all catch basins on a property and provide documentation for your maintenance records."},{"question":"What do you do with the material removed from the catch basin?","answer":"The sediment and debris we remove is transported in our vac truck and disposed of at an approved facility. We handle all waste disposal as part of the service."},{"question":"What areas do you serve for catch basin cleaning?","answer":"We serve residential, commercial, and municipal clients across London and Southwestern Ontario, including the City of London, Strathroy, St. Thomas, Woodstock, and surrounding communities. Contact us to confirm service availability in your area."}]',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310519663530669561/Bh4z4tJQ2oLgzVrvga4zYT/catchbasin-hero-JkGmHW6FquFgfJkBZyYHmH.webp',
  metaTitle = 'Catch Basin Cleaning London Ontario | Residential and Commercial | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Discount Drain cleans and repairs catch basins for residential, commercial, and municipal clients across London and Southwestern Ontario. Vac truck service, same-visit repairs, annual contracts. Call 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'catch-basin-cleaning';
